lesson_versions_reference_check.name: lesson_versions_reference_check
lesson_versions_reference_check.value: ((curated_reference_id IS NOT NULL) <> (source_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL))

lesson_versions_lineage_check.name: lesson_versions_lineage_check
lesson_versions_lineage_check.value: ((revision_kind = 'initial'::text) AND (parent_version_id IS NULL) AND (predecessor_version_id IS NULL) AND (revision = 1)) OR ((revision_kind = 'section-revision'::text) AND (parent_version_id IS NOT NULL) AND (predecessor_version_id IS NULL) AND (revision > 1)) OR ((revision_kind = 'reframe'::text) AND (parent_version_id IS NOT NULL) AND (predecessor_version_id IS NULL) AND (revision > 1)) OR ((revision_kind = 'fresh-draft'::text) AND (parent_version_id IS NULL) AND (revision = 1))

source_snapshots_page_count_check.name: source_snapshots_page_count_check
source_snapshots_page_count_check.value: page_count IS NULL OR (page_count >= 1 AND page_count <= 20)

source_snapshots_failure_reason_check.name: source_snapshots_failure_reason_check
source_snapshots_failure_reason_check.value: failure_reason IS NULL OR failure_reason = ANY (ARRAY['unsupported-format'::text, 'oversized-file'::text, 'too-many-pages'::text, 'encrypted'::text, 'empty-source'::text, 'encoding'::text, 'character-limit-exceeded'::text, 'parser-fault'::text, 'extraction-timeout'::text, 'interrupted'::text, 'personal-data'::text])

teacher_decisions_target_check.name: teacher_decisions_target_check
teacher_decisions_target_check.value: ((action = 'pause'::text) AND (approved_target_id IS NULL)) OR ((action = ANY (ARRAY['accept'::text, 'override'::text])) AND (approved_target_id IS NOT NULL))
